content.text: {"summary":"Estimated c as minus the slope of f with respect to v at v=0. Averaging the hidden-unit activation patterns over q and u gives a value close to the slope at the origin, about 0.70. To add -c*v, I used the two unused hidden units, 2 and 8. They are set to ReLU(v) and ReLU(-v), with output weights -c and +c.
